items.title: 7 Sci-Fi Shows Fans Either Love Or Hate
items.summary: Sci-fi TV shows are notoriously difficult to get right. The genre’s fandom can be fickle, and even the grandest ideas or most impressive visual spectacle cannot guarantee a series will succeed. Even the most celebrated sci-fi shows have detractors who are every bit as vocal as their supporters. The idea of a universally beloved science fiction series is basically a myth. However, some sci-fi shows take that divide to another level, earning reputations as timeless masterpieces and embarrassing low points in almost the same breath.

items.title: ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters
items.summary: The clichés stack up nearly as fast as the clever cast can distinguish them in Karin Slaughter's six-episode adaptation of her own book, which follows long-separated sisters who reunite to defend a young woman from the predators lurking in their brutish, backwoods hometown.
items.t: ‘The Good Daughter’ Review: Rose Byrne Sizzles in Peacock’s Brutal Trauma-Drama About Crime-Solving Sisters
